title: Management
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: There is no specific treatment for acute or chronic HDV infection.

The more risk population includes health care workers, transfusion recipients and haemophiliacs, PWID, and immigrants of endemic areas. Nucleotide sequences of HDV obtained worldwide indicates the existence of eight genotypes, with genotype 1 being detected worldwide. HDV Antiviral nucleotide analogues for HBV have no or limited effect on HDV replication and Pegylated interferon alpha is the only drug effective against HDV now and more than one year of therapy may be necessary as most of patients relapses after discontinuation of therapy.
